title: alert_events inputSchema
description: Argument shape for the platform-operations alert-events query tool (advertised name honua_alert_events). Read-only, paged (cursor-based): queries the alert-event history surfaced through the honua-server Console Operate alert API. Alert events come from two sources — spatial/threshold GIS alert rules (gis) and operations notifications not linked to an alert rule (ops). Filter by source, severity, rule, operator lifecycle state, and time range. The response is a page of alert events; see alert_events.result.schema.json. x-honua-reference-shape: this shape tracks the reference implementation.

source.description: Filter by alert source: 'gis' for spatial/threshold alert-rule events, 'ops' for operations notifications not linked to an alert rule.

rule.description: Filter by source alert-rule identifier or name.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound (ISO-8601) on the event observation time.

to.description: Exclusive upper bound (ISO-8601) on the event observation time.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of events to return in one page. The surface applies a server-defined default and maximum; an over-maximum request is clamped, not rejected.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a prior page's nextCursor; absent on the first page.
